comments.value: I'm not sure if I'd want a row dedicated to that, but having sdk2 and 3 worlds auto tagged so you can search for them would be neat?
If the authors are keywording 'SDK3' and 'Udon' in their Tags you could save theat as a search term, but it would be nice to find by SDK and release number.
Setting back to Open. We have a spotlight, but right now we don't have a technical method for us to list only SDK2/SDK3 worlds in a row. One day!

details: Would be great for world hopping to be able to find worlds using udon or sdk3!
title: World row that only shows worlds using SDK3
